reviews.review_title: Great comic app in 3D , smart idea
reviews.review_description:
First, thank you developers for this app.  I love this wonderful idea.  
And we can have more idea and options to this app, improve and increase its value. 
Keep simple easy user interface, allow easy to find how to use each functions.
Able to show label the function of the controller.  
The current page number , total page show all time or off.  
Jump to pages function is allowed , directly jump to any page.
Jump to volume function is allowed, 
Allow to create different tpye of book shelves to organize and store move volumes of book. 🙏🙏🙏
Able to read offline .  
Able to view in either landscape or portrait to its max viewing area if possible?

How to close the panel, after the panel is opened. 
Need to able to close the panel . 😫 missing close panel function 😢 

Great work, please continue to add more improvement and ideas to this beautiful happy app for everyone. 
Thank you very much.
